job.question: How many printed copies of the proposal must be submitted in the San Francisco Employees' Retirement System (SFERS) general investment consultant RFP?
job.expected_facts: Three (3) paper (hard) copies plus one full electronic copy.
job.acceptance: Three hard/paper/printed copies is fully correct. Electronic-copy mention is optional, not a required extra.

reviews.reason: The document is a New York City BERS investment consulting RFP, not the SFERS general investment consultant RFP. It requires submission by email and provides no support for an SFERS printed-copy requirement.
quotes: This Request for Proposals (“RFP”) is issued by the NYC Board of Education Retirement System (“BERS” or the “Agency”).
Each proposer must submit their proposal package via email to BERSProcurement@bers.nyc.gov.
